name: nexabuilder-web-to-apk
description: NexaBuilder dashboard and secure GitHub Actions bridge for packaging static websites as Android APKs.

scripts.check: node --check lib/nexa.js && node --check api/health.js && node --check api/upload/chunk.js && node --check api/upload/finalize.js && node --check 'api/jobs/[id].js' && node --check 'api/jobs/[id]/apk.js'
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
